people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

people.name: Jezebel
people.line: Queen of Israel; wife of King Ahab

translations.web: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
translations.bsb: Now Ahab told Jezebel everything that Elijah had done and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
translations.kjv: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
translations.asv: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
